lessons.title: MOS transistor curves
lessons.description: Place the SG13G2 NMOS and PMOS transistors and study their ID over VGS curves.

lessons.title: Current mirror
lessons.description: Build a current mirror with 10x current amplification.

lessons.title: Common-source amplifier
lessons.description: Size a single-transistor amplifier for a voltage gain of 5.

lessons.title: Differential pair
lessons.description: Build a resistively loaded differential pair.

lessons.title: Differential ring oscillator
lessons.description: Wire three differential pairs into a ring oscillator.

lessons.title: CMOS inverter
lessons.description: Build an inverter and center its switching threshold.

lessons.title: Self-biased inverter
lessons.description: Turn the inverter into an AC amplifier with resistive feedback.

lessons.title: NAND2 gate
lessons.description: Extend the inverter into a NAND2 gate.

lessons.title: Standard cells
lessons.description: Instantiate an XOR2 gate from the SG13G2 standard cell library and tour its layout.

lessons.title: Pseudo-random generator
lessons.description: Close the feedback of a shift register built from standard cells and turn it into an LFSR.

lessons.title: Bonus: 5-transistor OTA
lessons.description: Build an OTA meeting gain, current and swing specs.
